mainEntity.name: How do I change the language of the app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Settings → Appearance → Language. The app follows the device unless one is chosen; scripture is always shown in its own language.

mainEntity.name: How do I back up my notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Settings → Your material exports notes, bookmarks, projects and settings in one file. Import it on the other device.
Everything stays on this device. Translations are downloaded when asked for; nothing about the reader is sent anywhere, and there is no account.

mainEntity.name: How do I change the theme or colour?

acceptedAnswer.text: The theme follows the system, or keep one in Settings → Appearance, where the accent colour is chosen too.
